newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates-Prices steady to higher on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates-Prices steady to higher on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted steady to higher Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said.
No barges traded, just like Thursday.
- Two barges, Lower Ohio River, next week, bid 110 percent of tariff, offer 120 percent, up five percentage points from Thursday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 150 percent, no offer.
- One barge, Osceola through Cairo, Mississippi River, next week, bid 95 percent, no offer.
- Five barges, Illinois, one each week of March, bid 145 percent, offer 155 percent, up 10 percentage points, similar.
- Five barges, scattered and even, Mid-Mississippi, 30-day open, no bid, offered 165 percent, up five percentage points from Thursday.
- Five barges, scattered and even, 30-day open, Lacrose and Savage, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offer 200 percent, up five percent points from Thursday.
